panels.title: Error Rate (LogQL)
panels.description: Count of ERROR-level log lines from driver-service per minute. Spike detection — if driver-service logs many ERRORs in a short window, something is wrong.

panels.title: RabbitMQ Event Audit (LogQL)
panels.description: Log lines emitted by driver-service event publishers and consumers, filtered by routing key. Shows driver.status-changed, driver.rated, ride.placed, ride.completed, ride.cancelled events.

panels.title: Feign Call Outcomes (LogQL)
panels.description: Successful Feign calls vs FeignException catches from driver-service. Detects when ride-service or user-service is degraded.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate (PromQL)
panels.description: Requests per second per endpoint on driver-service. Shows which endpoints are under the most load.

panels.title: P99 Latency (PromQL)
panels.description: 99th percentile latency per endpoint on driver-service. High P99 on /api/drivers/{id}/earnings or /api/drivers/{id}/dashboard signals slow Feign calls to ride-service.

panels.title: Cache Hit/Miss Ratio (PromQL)
panels.description: Redis cache hits vs misses for driver-service. Verifies that S2-F12 dashboard caching is effective.
